tasks.label: Build SPADMIC report PDF (MiKTeX, no WSL)
args: $miktex = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\MiKTeX\miktex\bin\x64"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path build, dist | Out-Null; & "$miktex\pdflatex.exe" -interaction=nonstopmode -file-line-error -halt-on-error -synctex=1 -output-directory=build main.tex; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & "$miktex\biber.exe" --input-directory build --output-directory build main; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & "$miktex\pdflatex.exe" -interaction=nonstopmode -file-line-error -halt-on-error -synctex=1 -output-directory=build main.tex; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & "$miktex\pdflatex.exe" -interaction=nonstopmode -file-line-error -halt-on-error -synctex=1 -output-directory=build main.tex; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Copy-Item build\main.pdf dist\rapport_5psm.pdf -Force
